users.title: Users
users.intro: Manage the accounts that can sign in to PRANATA.
users.empty_description: Create the first account, then hand over its activation code in person.
users.empty_filtered_description: Change or clear the filters to see other users.

fields.name: Name
fields.email_hint: Optional. The account works without an email.
fields.email_locked_hint: Privileged account: only its owner can change its email, because a reset by email is sent to this address.
fields.staff_identifier_hint: Optional, such as an employee number or a vendor identity number.
fields.role_group_hint: Can only be chosen when the account is created.

form.create_intro: A new account gets a one-time activation code. You never know the user's password.
form.edit_intro: Changes are recorded in the audit trail.

detail.title: User details
detail.deactivated_note: This account has been deactivated. Its data and audit history are kept.
detail.suspended_note: This account is suspended and cannot sign in until it is reinstated.

secret.activation_intro: Hand this code to the user in person. It is shown only once and cannot be viewed again.
secret.activation_use_note: The user signs in with their username and this code, then must set a new password.
secret.temporary_password_intro: Hand this password to the account owner in person. It is shown only once and cannot be viewed again. All sessions of this account have ended.
secret.temporary_password_use_note: The user signs in with their username and this password, then must set a new password.

reset.title: Administrator-assisted password reset
reset.description: First make sure the person asking owns the account. The system makes a temporary password that is shown once and valid for 24 hours; the user must change it when signing in.
reset.privileged_description: This is a privileged account. Your request waits for a second administrator; the temporary password is made only after approval.
reset.note_placeholder: For example: the letter number or the officer who witnessed it
reset.pending_title: Reset waiting for a second administrator
reset.pending_expires: The request ends {{time}} if not approved.
reset.pending_own: You asked for this reset. Another administrator must approve it.

deactivation.title: Deactivate this account?
deactivation.description: The account can no longer sign in and all of its sessions end at once. Its data and audit history are kept. This cannot be undone from this screen.
deactivation.reason_placeholder: For example: transferred to another unit since 1 November

suspension.title: Suspend this account?
suspension.description: The account cannot sign in and all of its sessions end now. The password does not change; the account can be reinstated at any time.
suspension.reason_placeholder: For example: long leave until 1 December

reinstatement.title: Reinstate this account?
reinstatement.description: The user can sign in again with their own password.
reinstatement.reason_placeholder: For example: the employee is back on duty

sessions.intro: Devices that are signed in to this account.
sessions.empty: This account is not signed in on any device.
sessions.confirm_title: End all sessions of this account?
sessions.confirm_description: Active sessions: {{count}}. They all end now and the user must sign in again. The password does not change.

two_factor.enabled: 2FA is on. Signing in needs a code from the authenticator app.
two_factor.pending_setup: 2FA setup was started but not confirmed yet.
two_factor.required: This account must have 2FA before it can open Administration.
two_factor.title: Reset this account's 2FA?
two_factor.description: Use this only when the owner has lost their authenticator device. First make sure the person asking owns the account. A second administrator must approve; then 2FA and the recovery codes are removed and every session ends.
two_factor.pending_title: 2FA reset waiting for a second administrator
two_factor.pending_own: You asked for this 2FA reset. Another administrator must approve it.

organization.title: Organization
organization.intro: Units, positions and appointments. Every change is requested, checked and decided before it takes effect.
organization.empty_description: Start by requesting the top unit, such as the university. Other units can be added below it.
organization.choose_unit: Choose a unit in the tree to see its details, history and appointments.
organization.not_yet_effective: The decision is recorded. The change can be put into effect from {{date}}.

tree.label: Unit tree
tree.no_match: No unit matches. Change the search words.

fields.code_hint: Capital letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. It cannot change once the unit is in effect.
fields.position_code_hint: Capital letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter. For example HEAD_CS.
fields.name: Name
fields.unit_type_hint: Any type code, such as FACULTY, INSTITUTE, BUREAU or PROGRAM. Capital letters, digits or underscores.
fields.parent_hint: Leave empty when this unit is at the top.
fields.effective_to_hint: Optional. Leave empty when the term is not set yet.
fields.proposed_effective_from_hint: The official effective date is set in the decision.
fields.reason_placeholder: For example: units rearranged under the new statute
fields.source_ref_hint: Optional, such as a letter or memo number.
fields.decree_ref_hint: The number of the appointment decree.

history.intro: Every change is recorded as a new version; an earlier version is never overwritten.

positions.empty: No positions in this unit yet.

appointments.no_permission: An appointment records who holds a position. It grants no permission in PRANATA.
appointments.empty: No appointments in this unit yet.
appointments.none_active: This unit has no active appointment that can be ended.

requests.unit_empty: No change requests for this unit yet.
requests.open_empty: No change request is in progress.

kind_hints.CREATE_UNIT: A new unit with its code, name, type and parent.
kind_hints.UPDATE_UNIT: Name, short name or unit type. The earlier version stays in the history.
kind_hints.MOVE_UNIT: The unit and every unit below it move to a new parent.
kind_hints.DEACTIVATE_UNIT: The unit is no longer used. Units below it and its active appointments must be settled first.
kind_hints.ACTIVATE_UNIT: An inactive unit is used again.
kind_hints.CREATE_POSITION: An official position or function in this unit.
kind_hints.APPOINT: A staff member holds a position for a term, with a decree reference.
kind_hints.END_APPOINTMENT: The appointment ends on the effective date of the decision.

status_hints.DRAFT: Complete it, then send it to be checked.
status_hints.VALIDATED: Review the check results, then send it for a decision or return it to draft.
status_hints.AWAITING_DECISION: Waiting for the decision of the authorized official.
status_hints.APPROVED: Decided. The change takes effect once it is put into effect on its date.
status_hints.EFFECTIVE: The change is in effect and recorded in the unit history.
status_hints.SUPERSEDED: Replaced by a newer change. Its history is kept.
status_hints.WITHDRAWN: The request was withdrawn. The organization did not change.
status_hints.REJECTED: The request was rejected. The organization did not change.

form.intro: The request is saved as a draft. The organization changes only after it is decided and put into effect.
form.for_unit: For the unit {{name}}. The organization changes only after it is decided and put into effect.

policy.blocked_description: An official decision cannot be recorded yet because the organization maintenance policy is not officially in force (GAP-021). The request is kept and can be withdrawn.
policy.simulation_description: The organization maintenance policy is not officially in force. In this environment the decision is recorded as a simulation and marked in the history.

issues.other_open_request: Another request for this unit is in progress. Make sure the two do not conflict.
issues.parent_missing: The parent unit was not found.
issues.name_duplicate: A unit with the same name already exists under this parent.
issues.nothing_changes: The entries match the data in force; nothing changes.
issues.move_into_own_subtree: A unit cannot move below itself or below one of its own units.
issues.has_active_children: There are still active units below this unit.
issues.has_active_appointments: There are still active appointments in this unit.
issues.person_missing: The staff member was not found.
issues.person_not_eligible: This account cannot hold a position: only active internal accounts can.
issues.already_appointed: This staff member already holds that position.
issues.appointment_missing: The appointment was not found in this unit.

return.title: Return to draft?
return.description: The request can be corrected and sent again. Write what needs correcting.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this request?
withdraw.description: The request is closed and the organization does not change. Its history is kept.

decision.title: Record the decision
decision.description: Record the decision of the authorized official with its number.
decision.simulation_description: The policy is not officially in force yet, so this decision is recorded as a simulation.
decision.effective_hint: For an approval. Not before today.
